name: PIPP Plus
description: Pay a set share of your income for gas and electric instead of the full bill, all year.
eligibility: For homes with a lower income that get gas or electric from a big power company. For one person, the limit is about $27,900 a year.

steps: Apply online at energyhelpohio.gov, or ask your local help agency.
You will also need to apply for HEAP.
how_to_use.what_to_expect: You pay 5% of your monthly household income for each of gas and electric (10% in an all-electric home, at least $10).
